REPORT

COMPLAINT 202154321

Ashdown Vale Housing Trust

30/09/2022

Our approach

Invented approach text for the fixture.

The complaint

  1. The complaint is about the trust’s response to reports of mould in the bathroom.
  2. The complaint is also about the trust’s complaint handling.

Background

  1. The resident lives in a flat let by the trust.
  2. The resident reported mould in the bathroom in January 2022. The trust said:
    • it would fit an extractor fan;
    • it would treat the walls.

The resident’s window repairs

  1. The resident also asked for new window seals.

Assessment and findings

  1. The trust fitted the fan within its target time.
  2. The trust’s complaint response was sent six weeks late.

Determination

  1. In accordance with paragraph 53 of the Scheme, there was no maladministration in the trust’s response to the reports of mould.
  2. In accordance with paragraph 52 of the Scheme, there was service failure in the trust’s complaint handling.

Recommendations

  1. The trust should review how long its complaint responses take.
